board: ESP32-DevKitC V4 with ESP32-WROOM-32E (original ESP32, not S3/C3/WROVER)
camera_connection: Separate ESP32-CAM over local Wi-Fi; no shared camera GPIO or SD slot on main board
audio_clock: Mic and amplifier share BCLK/WS. Prototype voice mode uses matching clock rates; Mac resamples audio. Stop/duck A2DP before voice clock changes.
notes: GPIO34/35/39 have no internal pull-ups; use the specified external resistors to 3.3V.
GPIO16/17 allocation requires WROOM, not WROVER with reserved PSRAM pins.
Avoid flash pins 6-11 and boot strapping pins 0,2,5,12,15.
7-pin LCD has no assumed separate backlight input; verify purchased pinout and supply before wiring.
RTC SDA/SCL pull-ups must go to 3.3V, not 5V.
GPIO16 now drives PCA9685 OE, with 10k pull-up to 3.3V: disabled until power is confirmed. Neck and future shoulders use PCA9685 channels 0,1,2.
HUSB238 must select only the 5V PDO and confirm its negotiated 5A contract before enabling all three servos. Do not assume a connector or charger label establishes the negotiated current.
GPIO39 is exposed as VN on the DevKitC V4. Use esp:VN in Wokwi wiring and GPIO39 in firmware.
